intro: T2 · Elementary · Understand the meaning and details of everyday written exchanges; understand notices, timetables and simple descriptive texts. Topic: Services and returns. Focus: Reading and spelling.

palabras.palabra: เปลี่ยนสินค้า

texto: Reading and spelling in transactions and receipts: «ใบเสร็จ» has the vowel ใ in front of บ, and «เสร็จ» has the initial consonant ส, the shortened vowel เ...็ and the final consonant จ (which sounds like [t] in แม่กด, low tone). «สินค้า» has the high-class consonant ส (rising tone) and the low-class consonant ค with ้ (high tone). «เสีย» has the high-class consonant ส with the diphthong เ...ีย in a natural rising tone. Reading these terms lets you check the warranties and conditions printed on receipts.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ศูนย์บริการลูกค้าพร้อมให้คำแนะนำเกี่ยวกับขั้นตอนการเคลมประกันสินค้า» express?

opciones.texto: The customer service desk advises on official warranty procedures.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ศูนย์บริการลูกค้าพร้อมให้คำแนะนำเกี่ยวกับขั้นตอนการเคลมประกันสินค้า» from the text.

opciones.texto: Keeping the proof of purchase speeds up checking your order.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: The refund policy clearly specifies deadlines and requirements.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: In the word «ใบเสร็จ» (receipt), how does the final consonant จ of the syllable «เสร็จ» sound?

opciones.texto: As a voiceless alveolar stop [t] (แม่กด group)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: the consonant จ in final syllable position is pronounced as a [t] stop.
Incorrect: at the end of a Thai syllable, affricates are neutralised to [t].
Incorrect: จ is a stop, not a nasal consonant.
